# Known solutions

Read the lines here before investigating a problem: the symptom may already be known. `open` means understood but not fixed yet. Rules: [[kb-rules]].

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-indexes.py from each note's description: edit the notes, not this file. -->

## Notes

- [[brave-extension-worker-cached]] — OPEN (fix in owneet-base 0.0.39, to verify on a real update): a used web app profile gets a changed extension worker only when the manifest's version AND the worker's file name both change; one alone keeps the old worker or leaves none.
- [[brave-native-messaging-host-not-found]] — Brave never starts owneet-bridge: the native-messaging manifest in the web app's profile is ignored. Also the step-by-step path to see Brave's hidden errors.
- [[brave-widevine-window-over-a-web-app]] — Brave shows its own window 'Restart browser to enable Google Widevine' (Block / Allow) over a web app; the controller cannot close it. Comes after every Widevine download.
- [[build-chroot-emptied-by-systemd-tmpfiles]] — Package builds stop with 'does not appear to be an Arch chroot' and a missing makepkg.conf: systemd emptied the build chroot, then under /var/tmp, after 30 days.
- [[controller-without-standard-layout-in-brave]] — In a web app LT / RT and the D-pad do nothing (the left stick, A and B work), and the right stick scrolls oddly: Brave reports the controller with no layout (mapping \"\"), in the Linux driver's order.
- [[empty-files-after-an-update-and-a-hard-stop]] — A package installed with pacman, then the machine stopped by hand: the package's files are 0 bytes (\"Exec format error\", the interface does not start). How to see it and repair it.
- [[gamescope-overlay-window-not-drawn-or-left-on-screen]] — A window meant as a gamescope external overlay is treated as an ordinary window (not drawn over the app), or its picture stays on screen after it is hidden. Seen on real hardware only, not in the VM.
- [[going-back-keeps-the-newer-package-database]] — Going back to an older OwneetOS release fails with 'signature … is invalid' for the owneet database, or keeps Arch's newer packages: pacman -Sy keeps the newer databases; -Syy fixes it.
- [[site-intro-words-take-clicks]] — Buttons in the middle of the website do not react and show a text cursor: the start-up animation's invisible words stayed over the page, because a child's visibility: visible outlives the host's hidden.
- [[steam-cannot-add-a-disk-from-its-controller-interface]] — Steam's storage (controller interface) has no 'Add drive': a second disk cannot be chosen to install a Steam game. The system must hand the disk to Steam with steam://addlibraryfolder, as SteamOS does.
- [[steam-loading-for-ever-after-b]] — B on Steam's home page leaves Steam on an endless loading screen; Guide still comes back, closing Steam clears it. Seen since 2026-10-13; no sign of it in Steam's logs; the cause is not proved.
- [[steam-loses-the-address-while-its-interface-starts]] — Steam started from the console shows its logo, flickers, passes by its home or stays there, instead of the page asked for: its interface was not ready. How to know when it is, on any computer.
- [[test-vm-ignores-the-iso]] — The test VM never starts the ISO (or the installed disk): the firmware goes straight to PXE / HTTP boot and stops in the UEFI shell. Stale firmware boot entries; vm/test.sh reset or vm/vm.sh reset-firmware.
- [[tester-pc-misses-a-new-package]] — A feature works in the test VM but not on a tester PC updated from the OWNEETLOG stick: a file is missing (\"no such file or directory\") because it lives in a package the PC never had.
- [[vm-run-hangs-after-exit]] — `vm/test.sh run` waits until its time is up and the VM never runs the command (the server sees no request): an `exit` in an earlier part of the command closed the VM's debug shell.
- [[windows-games-quit-at-once-empty-umu-shim]] — Every Windows game (and owneet-windows-run) ends at once with exit 0, no error, and the prefix is never made (drive_c holds only users): umu's ~/.local/share/umu/umu-shim is a 0-byte file after a hard stop.
- [[windows-installer-folder-with-a-colon]] — A Windows installer ends after a few seconds and the console says Windows games are not ready: the game's folder name has a character Windows refuses (\":\" in \"The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings\").
